parsed.name: BioTek Cytation微孔板成像读板仪
parsed.description: Cytation是一类带显微成像功能的微孔板读板仪，可对多孔板样品进行自动对焦、位移扫描、明场或滤光片成像，并支持相机曝光、增益、物镜和照明设置。它常用于细胞培养板成像、荧光/明场观察以及自动化板式实验的数据采集。
parsed.description_en: The Cytation is a microplate reader with integrated microscopy-style imaging. It can autofocus, move across wells, perform brightfield or filtered imaging, and control camera exposure, gain, objectives, and illumination. It is commonly used for imaging cell culture plates, fluorescence or brightfield observation, and automated data collection in plate-based assays.
